assessment.nobel_worthiness: A poet and essayist whose work remade modern Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained argument with the inherited classical tradition. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are representative, and the essayistic writing on Arabic poetics extends the formal achievement. Voice, linguistic innovation and a durable body of work across several decades are all strong under common criteria.
assessment.attribution: A citation would rest on poetic renewal of the Arabic language and on the critical and essayistic reflection on tradition that accompanies it. The credit sits with a single writer, so no attribution problem arises. The scope should not turn into a political or biographical symbol and should stay with the literary work.
assessment.maturity: A very long, internally coherent career whose influence on later Arabic poetry is widely discussed in public criticism. The oeuvre looks fully mature, and the timing question is about candidate age and not about development.
uncertainties: Poetry in translation loses much of the prosodic and intertextual work, so the judgment leans on secondary accounts and partial translations.
Coverage of the full Arabic corpus, including the later volumes, is uneven in my knowledge.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike, anti-realist fiction that disrupts ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. The voice is highly distinctive and the formal project is consistent across a large body of stories and novels, including Frontier and Love in the New Millennium. The imaginative and intellectual ambition is high, and her writing has a recognisable relationship to Western modernist and philosophical traditions without being derivative.
assessment.attribution: A citation would honour a uniquely uncompromising narrative method that resists realist expectations. Credit is to one writer. A reader should also consider her critical writing on literature, which frames the fiction.
assessment.maturity: Several decades of sustained experiment with little visible dilution of method. The risk is repetitiveness of mode, which readers may judge differently depending on how much of the corpus they know.
uncertainties: Translated coverage is partial and the quality of translations varies, so the stylistic assessment is provisional.
Whether the formal sameness across books reflects depth or limitation is contestable.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that blur classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red reworks the Geryon myth as a verse novel, and Nox is a book-object elegy that combines translation, commentary and personal grief. The intellectual depth and formal invention are exceptional, and the work has influenced contemporary poetry in English.
assessment.attribution: Citation scope would be formal reinvention of the poetic and essayistic book through dialogue with the classical tradition. One writer; her translations of ancient texts are part of the practice but should not be counted as independent merit.
assessment.maturity: A substantial, consistently inventive body of work across roughly three decades. Some later projects are more occasional and performance-oriented, which affects how uniformly sustained the whole appears.
uncertainties: Some work depends on visual and material form that reproduction and translation can reduce.
Whether the learned allusiveness counts as depth or as a narrower appeal is debated.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose that turns memory, the body and dream into an expansive metaphysical project. Blinding and Solenoid show ambitious architecture and a strongly marked voice, with a link to Romanian poetic and postmodern traditions. The imaginative reach is large and the sentence-level achievement is notable in the available translations.
assessment.attribution: A citation would center on fiction as cosmology of inner life, supplemented by his poetry. One writer. His position within Romanian literature is distinct and cannot be reduced to a regional label.
assessment.maturity: A long, cumulative project in which the large works build on one another. Whether the late, very long books justify their scale is a point on which readers differ.
uncertainties: Judging Romanian prose style depends on translations whose fidelity I cannot confirm.
The poetry and early work are less well covered in translation than the major novels.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic novels that bring Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time into the English-language novel. Carpentaria and The Swan Book show a fully formed narrative voice and an ambitious structure. The nonfiction, including collective-memory work, extends the project, and the combination of formal invention and historical depth is considerable.
assessment.attribution: A citation would focus on remaking the novel through Indigenous storytelling and language, with a distinct Waanyi-Australian perspective. One writer. The scope has to rest on the literary form and not on the political significance of the subject.
assessment.maturity: The major novels are few and long, so the body of work is smaller than some others on the list, though it has been consistently ambitious. The question is whether the number of works is enough for a lifetime-achievement standard.
uncertainties: A smaller number of large novels makes the sustained-quality judgment more dependent on two or three books.
Reception of the most recent work is not known to me in detail.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large poetic sequences such as Purgatory and Anteparadise transform suffering and national catastrophe into collective, monumental form, and his public, landscape-scale pieces extend the poem beyond the page. The ambition and formal courage are notable, and the thread from Chilean history to a wider lyric tradition gives depth.
assessment.attribution: A citation would honour poetry as memorial and collective act, with the monumental projects as an extension. One writer. A risk is that the political and public dimension is weighted more than the poetic language itself.
assessment.maturity: A long, consistent career with sustained engagement from the 1970s onward. The relationship between the page poems and the public works makes the totality harder to assess.
uncertainties: Spanish-language poetry in translation is hard to judge, and I cannot verify the quality of English versions.
The landscape-scale pieces are known mainly through description and documentation.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Linguistic invention that brings oral storytelling and neologism into novels of war, memory and postcolonial life in Mozambique. Sleepwalking Land and Confession of the Lioness show a distinctive voice and an imaginative reach that combines the folkloric with sharp historical observation. His work builds a Portuguese that is marked by Mozambican speech.
assessment.attribution: A citation would center on the renewal of Portuguese narrative through Mozambican oral and linguistic resources. One writer. Poetry and short fiction complement the novels.
assessment.maturity: Several decades of steady output with a clear voice. Some later works may repeat earlier registers, and this affects how strongly the overall body of work reads as developing.
uncertainties: The neologistic language is hard to carry into translation, so what I know of the style is indirect.
Coverage of the full corpus, particularly the poetry, is partial.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Encyclopedic fiction that links systems of power, scientific knowledge and countercultural imagination. Gravity's Rainbow and Mason & Dixon show exceptional range of register, formal ambition and intellectual density, and the influence on later American and international fiction is large. The sustained quality of the central works is high.
assessment.attribution: A citation would acknowledge encyclopedic, systems-minded fiction of unusual linguistic range. One writer. Public information about the author is minimal, so the assessment rests on the books alone, which is appropriate.
assessment.maturity: A long career with major works at different stages. Some later novels are judged less central than the major works, which affects the claim of uniformly sustained quality.
uncertainties: The relation of the work to the idealistic direction in Nobel's will is open to differing readings.
Reception of the later novels is mixed, and I cannot verify details.
No independent verification of sources is claimed.
